Question 6

Calculate ∫(15x+2+15x−2)dx. Assume that K is an arbitrary positive constant.

a
 5ln⁡(K|(5x+2)(5x−2)|)
b
 ln⁡(K|5x+25x−2|)
c

 5ln⁡(K|5x+25x−2|)
